note: Adversarial drawing-region quality signals (TR-233 / Red Team A5). Each case MUST assess to a non-READABLE quality (usable_for_auto_read=false): a bad or unknown scan is never 'no violations'. Signal-level fixtures only: the system does NOT do human-level CV (cv_human_level=MISSING) -- a stamp/handwriting/bad scan is modeled via the degraded signals it produces (low dpi, skew, few recognized chars, corrupt NaN/inf, or absent signals), not by recognizing the stamp itself. NaN/inf encoded as strings ('nan'/'inf') to keep valid JSON.

cases.description: 60 dpi scan below the unreadable floor
OCR found no text (blank or failed extraction)
handwritten note: OCR recognizes almost nothing
stamp over text: mild skew plus reduced recognized text
corrupt/failed measurements (NaN/inf) with text must not fall through to readable
text present but resolution unknown -> cannot confirm readable
no quality signals provided at all
